# PerfektBlue 2.0

### Bluetooth-first. Evidence-driven. Built for real research workflows.

</div>

PerfektBlue 2.0 replaces the original proof of concept with a complete, modular security
assessment framework. The new engine discovers Bluetooth targets through BlueZ, correlates
evidence, matches versioned target profiles, selects compatible modules, and produces
reproducible exploitability reports.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> PerfektBlue does not guess payload offsets, architectures, ports, or injection paths.
> Active verification requires a tested target profile and compatible module. Unknown targets
> are mapped and reported without fabricated exploit claims.

## ✨ Highlights

| Area | PerfektBlue 2.0 |
| --- | --- |
| Bluetooth | BlueZ D-Bus discovery for Classic Bluetooth and BLE |
| Fingerprinting | Explainable weighted profile matching with contradictions |
| Intelligence | Adaptive module planning based on live evidence and confidence |
| Assessment | Precise injectable, blocked, inconclusive, and unsupported verdicts |
| Reporting | Persistent sessions plus terminal, JSON, and standalone HTML reports |
| Safety | Passive-by-default policy with explicit lab-active authorization |
| CAN | Isolated as the optional `perfektblue-can` plugin |
| Distribution | Python wheel, source archive, reproducible `.deb`, checksums, and SBOM |

## 🔍 Bluetooth intelligence

- Enumerates adapters, devices, service UUIDs, GATT services, characteristics, flags, handles,
  manufacturer data, RSSI, device class, and link-security state.
- Builds a capability-aware assessment plan and explains why every module runs or is skipped.
- Uses target-profile confidence thresholds before considering active verification.
- Stores evidence and findings in an indexed session database for later reporting.

## 🧪 Verified assessment model

The framework now uses explicit verdict semantics:

- `confirmed-injectable` — a compatible module produced its required proof.
- `blocked` — a known path was tested and rejected by a mitigation.
- `no-known-path` — the matched profile has no installed verified path.
- `inconclusive` — evidence or authorization was insufficient.
- `unsupported` — no target profile matched.

The release includes vulnerable, patched, and unknown simulators so profile authors can test all
verdict paths without real hardware.

## 📦 Installation

Download `perfektblue_2.0.0-1_all.deb` from the assets below:

```bash
sudo apt install ./perfektblue_2.0.0-1_all.deb
perfektblue doctor
perfektblue wizard
```

Python installation:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install perfektblue-2.0.0-py3-none-any.whl
perfektblue doctor
```

## ⚠️ Authorized use

Use PerfektBlue only on systems you own or have explicit written permission to assess. Automotive
and Bluetooth systems may be safety-critical. Use isolated labs, simulators, and controlled test
benches.

Full usage and architecture documentation is available in the repository
[README](https://github.com/Nour833/PerfektBlue#readme).
